text.formatted: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
text.plain: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

text.formatted: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and it knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
text.plain: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and it knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +5, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

text.formatted: _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 13, one creature the spider can see within 60 feet. _Failure:_ The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage).
text.plain: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature the spider can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage).
